title: On-Adapter-L: training loss aligned with the tail metric
frozen_at: 2026-10-09, after round 8 (validation re-selected the round-5 configuration; no test computed) and before any round-9 training (one Traffic H6 smoke cell of msetail excepted)
exploratory_disclosure: Exploratory; the seed-2 test period has been used seven times.
test_use_policy: test streams are evaluated only if the selected candidate is not the round-5 configuration AND its robust validation score is <= 0.985

hypothesis.problem: The main statistic is the CVaR90 of per-origin MAE, but the adapter is trained with element-wise MSE, which weights errors differently from the evaluated tail of per-origin MAE.
hypothesis.change: a0e15 recipe with the training/online loss replaced by (mae) observed-element MAE, or (msetail) MSE + mean of the worst ceil(10%) per-origin observed MAEs in each batch. Checkpoint selection stays validation MSE (protocol).
hypothesis.falsified_if: validation does not select a loss variant with robust score <= 0.985

candidate_note: second element = round-5 backbone-first gate (gs 0.9, mu 0); online rule lr0; entry seed 200 (r=0)
selection: seed-2 validation; robust score = max(whole GM, largest per-third GM) of the CVaR90 ratio to iTransformer over 36 tasks; argmin; ties toward a0e15+gate
